## Objective
- Make the existing survival horror game playable and improved on mobile, as well as PC and laptop.

## Requirements
- Add mobile-friendly movement, looking, flashlight, and gameplay action controls.
- Preserve the horror premise, exploration, puzzles, stealth, and escape.
- Multiplayer is local-only; there is no network matchmaking or server.

## Decisions
- Add touch controls directly to the existing game UI: movement stick, drag-to-look area, sprint, interact, flashlight, objectives, and pause.
- Show touch controls only on coarse-pointer devices while gameplay is active.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added touch-control markup, responsive styling, safe-area spacing, and HUD layering.
- Added touch movement, look, sprint, interaction/revive, flashlight, objectives, and pause handling.
- Preserved desktop keyboard/mouse handling and disabled pointer-lock requests on coarse-pointer devices.
- `node --check src/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Verify touch controls and mobile layout in-browser, then check desktop controls and layout for regressions.

### Blocked
- Browser testing script could not launch because its configured browser is headed and no X server was available; rerun with `xvfb-run` or a headless browser configuration.

## Next Move
1. Rerun mobile/desktop browser playtests using Xvfb or headless Chromium; verify touch movement, look, sprint, interaction/revive, flashlight, objectives, and pause.
2. Check desktop controls and layout for regressions.
3. Summarize the local-only multiplayer limitation when reporting completion.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Touch-control markup within the game UI.
- `src/game.js`: Touch input handlers and integration with gameplay.
- `style.css`: Touch HUD styling and responsive layout.
- `/tmp/opencode/mobile-playtest.cjs`: Browser test script created for mobile and desktop checks.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `src/game.js`, and `style.css`.
- Multiplayer remains local-only; no network matchmaking or server is available.
- `package.json` has no configured test suite.
